why: Count circles plus squares in each box. Row 1 always has 6 (4+2, 3+3, 2+4), row 2 always has 4 (3+1, 2+2, 1+3), so row 3 always has 2 (2+0, 1+1, 0+2). Also circles go down by one and squares go up by one along each row. Option 4 has no circles and 2 squares. Option 1 has only 1 shape.
trick: Count the small shapes and add them; each row often has the same total.
